Class GavRepository

java.lang.Object
org.mavendb.api.GavRepository
@Repository public class GavRepository extends Object
All SQL of the API. Every query is an indexed lookup on the loader's SQLite schema (db/sqlite/create.sql and data-refresh.sql in mavendb-loader).

    • findByFileName

      List<Gav> findByFileName(String fileName)
      Files with this name; uses index idx_gav_file_name. The same name can exist in several groups, like core-1.0.jar.

    • findBySha1

      List<Gav> findBySha1(String sha1)

    • findLatest

      Optional<LatestVersion> findLatest(String groupId, String artifactId)
      Highest version of an artifact by version_seq (the loader's sortable version number, so 3.10 sorts after 3.9); ties, like 2.0-RC1 and 2.0, go to the newer file. Uses index idx_gav.
